title: Forensic Science, B.S. (Eberly College of Science)
notes: Forensic Molecular Biology option, University Park (of two options — the other, Forensic Chemistry, substitutes CHEM 227/FRNSC 425/427W for the BMB/FRNSC 420/421W sequence used here). The bulletin's suggested plan also lists 'FRNSC 415W' in both Third Year Spring and Fourth Year Fall, which is very likely a scrape duplication (the course isn't a 2-part sequence) — modeled once, in Third Year Spring, with a General Elective slot in its place the second time. CONFIRMED via the bulletin's own separate, authoritative 'Requirements for the Major' course table (distinct from its Suggested Academic Plan table): FRNSC 415W appears there exactly once (2 credits), verifying the prior session's duplication call was correct. HANDBOOK CROSS-CHECK found one real, previously entirely unmodeled requirement: the Forensic Molecular Biology Option's own 'Additional Courses' table has a 'Select one of the following: 3' pick -- BIOL 405, BIOL 422, BIOL 460, BMB 402, BMB 428, or BMB 433 -- on top of the already-modeled 'BIOL 222 or 322' pick; together with the option's 4 prescribed courses (BMB 401/442, FRNSC 420/421W) these two picks make up the option's full 19 credits. This plan previously had no distinct item for it at all (only two generic 'Supporting Course (per adviser)' slots, seemingly meant for the university-level 'Electives 5-10' bucket instead) -- replaced one of those two with a real 6-option course item for this specific requirement, leaving the other 'Supporting Course (per adviser)' and both 'General Elective' slots untouched since the bulletin gives no further enumerated list for those. 'etm' marks the gateway courses (Calc I, Chem I) everything downstream depends on. Post-scraper-fix repair: CHEM 110's real prereq is MATH 22, which was never in this plan at all -- and MATH 22 itself real-chains through MATH 21, MATH 4, and MATH 3, none of which were in the plan either, leaving CHEM 110 (and everything chained off CHEM 111/112/113/210/212/213 and FRNSC 210) permanently unschedulable. Added MATH 3/4/21/22. Separately, BMB 401, BMB 442, FRNSC 413, and FRNSC 420 all real-need one of BIOL 230M/230W/BMB 251/MICRB 201/MICRB 202/MICRB 251 -- none of which this plan's BIOL 114/115/234/235W intro track otherwise provides -- added BMB 251 (real prereq: CHEM 112, already here) and MICRB 201 (real prereq: CHEM 110, already here), which together satisfy all four courses' real prereq groups. Also replaced the generic 'Genetics course (BIOL 222 or 322)' slot with the real BIOL 222 course (its real prereq is satisfied via BMB 251/MICRB 201 above) -- the previous assumption that 'nothing downstream depends on BIOL 222/322 specifically' no longer holds under the corrected parser: FRNSC 420's real prereq_groups is an AND of three groups, one of which is literally (BIOL 222 or BIOL 322), so the generic slot could never have satisfied it. STALE NOTE, NOW RESOLVED (leaving this correction visible rather than silently deleting the history): a previous session's note here flagged BIOL 234/BIOL 235W as circularly deadlocked in biol_catalog.json (234 needing 235W-or-236W, while both labs needed 234 first). Re-checked directly against the current biol_catalog.json: BIOL 234's and BIOL 235W's real prereq_groups are now both just the intro sequence (BIOL 110/110H/114 or BIOL 110/110H/115/116) -- the catalog has since been re-scraped/corrected and no circularity exists anymore. Confirmed via build_full_plan: both courses schedule cleanly with zero warnings.
